whyItMatters: vm.runInNewContext evaluates strings as javascript code, so untrusted input reaching it becomes code injection.
actions: Replace vm.runInNewContext with vm with a frozen context or no evaluation so untrusted input stays data, never code.
If evaluation must stay, isolate it in a sandbox without file, network, or credential access.
Re-run the scan and confirm no vm.runInNewContext call remains reachable from untrusted input.
verification: Rescan shows no vm.runInNewContext reachable from untrusted input, and injection probes stay inert data.
